# Vendored libraries

Served from this site instead of a CDN, so pages make no third-party requests for them. Each file is the exact release
file from jsDelivr; the integrity hashes in the templates (pinned in the Wowchemy theme's data/assets.toml, or in
assets/js/head-enhancements.js for tsParticles) were checked against these copies on 2026-10-24.

| Library | Version | Used by | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fuse.js | 3.2.1 | site search (layouts/partials/site_js.html) | Apache-2.0 |
| mark.js (jQuery) | 8.11.1 | search result highlighting | MIT |
| Academicons | 1.9.2 | academic profile icons (layouts/partials/site_head.html) | font: SIL OFL 1.1; CSS: MIT |
| tsParticles | 2.12.0 | home page background (assets/js/head-enhancements.js) | MIT |
| ECharts, Leaflet, Leaflet.markercluster | see folders | research dashboard and map | Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, MIT |
